statements:
```text
request_evaluated -> token matches (owner | exactly one agent) in constant_time
unknown_token -> one_refusal (reveals nothing)
owner_only_action -> actor = owner
author_action -> actor = agent AND agent.may_author
request -> schema_valid AND size <= surface_request_bytes_max
agent_text -> data (never evaluated in kernel process)
page_size <= page_size_max
```

verdicts.why: The check validates schemas for the operations returned, explicitly detects only three required operation names, checks a union has multiple object variants, and verifies the kernel continues serving. It cannot detect omission of any other catalogue operation because it iterates only over returned tools, and it does not assert constant-time token matching, uniform unknown-token refusal, owner/author authorization, request-size enforcement, non-evaluation of agent text, or page-size bounds.
